newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway government sees oil output rising in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Norway government sees oil output rising in 1997.

text.p: Oil production on the Norwegian continental shelf is expected to rise by around 100,000 barrels per day (bpd) in 1997 to 3.2 million bpd, the government said on Friday.
Sales of natural gas were forecast at just over 41 billion cubic metres compared with 35 billion this year, it said.
The estimates were contained in the government's budget proposal for 1997.
A Reuter survey of oil companies operating in Norwegian waters put production in July at a record 3.21 million bpd, including condensate production.
Norway uses just 150,000 bpd for domestic demand and is the second largest crude exporter after Saudi Arabia.

The government revised upwards its oil price forecast for 1996 to 125 crowns per barrel from projections of 115 crowns in the revised 1996 budget in May. Oil prices were expected to average 115 crowns per barrel in 1997, it said.

State revenues from petroleum activities in 1997 were estimated around the same level as this year at about 65 billion crowns. The export value from hydrocarbon production was put at 155 billion crowns next year, based on an average oil price of 115 crowns per barrel.

The government said investment in the petroleum sector was expected to remain at a high level at around 53.3 billion crowns in 1997 compared with 55.2 billion crowns in 1996. The figures include exploration drilling and activities based on land.

"The estimate for investments in 1997 is based on projects which have already been decided to be developed. Investments in future years will largely depend on how fast decisions are made to develop new projects," a statement from the Energy Ministry said.

State net cashflow from petroleum activities were expected to amount to about 65 billion crowns in 1997, comprising 35 billion crowns in tax and duties from oil companies, 29 billion crowns from the state's direct financial interest and 1.3 billion crowns from state oil company Den norske stats oljeselskap AS.
